note: After the revision by Constantino (1995), the original in English. The soldier and large worker are described. Alate measurements: 6 individuals from 5 colonies, head length 1.90—2.10 mm, head width without compound eyes 2.15—2.40 mm, fontanelle length 0.17—0.34 mm, pronotum length 1.33—1.30 mm (so in the OCR of the original), width 2.35—2.55 mm, hind tibia length 3.65—4.10 mm, maximum diameter of the compound eye 0.78—0.82 mm, ocellus length 0.30—0.40 mm, forewing length 24.50—26.00 mm. Soldier measurements: 11 soldiers from 11 colonies, head length 2.85—3.65 mm, maximum head width 2.20—2.85 mm, head height without postmentum 1.45—1.85 mm, frontal tube length 0.05—0.10 mm, left mandible length 1.65—1.95 mm, curvature 0.38—0.55 mm, left mandible M1—M2 distance 0.15—0.20 mm. The original is labelled sp. n. (new species).

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The closest species is S. molestus. The present species has a smaller and darker alate, a proportionally narrower pronotum and a smaller fontanelle. The soldier is smaller, the sides of the head are parallel, the mandibles are less hooked, and the posterior part of the postmentum bears several setae.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule elongate, sides nearly parallel; posterior margin of the head rounded or weakly trilobed. Frontal tube very short, its aperture clearly visible in dorsal view. Labrum elongate, longer than wide; lateral corners of the labrum obtuse; median lobe elongate, longer than the lateral lobes. Antennae 19-segmented. Postmentum as in the original.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Large worker: head capsule with many erect setae; postclypeus with about 6 setae; fontanelle small and slightly elongate. Antennae 19 or 20-segmented. Lateral margins of the thoracic tergites angular but without spines. Mandibles: apical tooth of the left mandible small, the cutting edge of M1 of the left mandible slightly undulate, M1 of the right mandible nearly equal to it; molar plate narrow, the basal notch distinct.
